testo:
Hyper Energy
■ You may put the top 5 cards of your deck into your graveyard. If you do, choose one of your opponent's creatures. That creature gets -1000 power for each card in your graveyard until the end of the turn. (A creatures that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
